summary: The comment from ESC Region 12 E-Rate Consulting supports a clear definition of consultant to ensure practical implementation and clarify obligations based on specific tasks performed. The text discusses various aspects of the E-Rate program, including its eligibility scope, consultant registration, and certification requirements. It mentions that the implementation of special construction or dark fiber would impose additional administrative burdens on school districts. The text also emphasizes the importance of focusing on organizational registration and using secure identity-proofing mechanisms for data security. The comment opposes sunset provisions for E-Rate funding and supports maintaining current rules for E-Rate consulting and training requirements.
